scripts._prompt: echo 'Set the "$TAG" environment variable to e.g. v1.0.1 - default is latest' && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && echo TAG set to ${TAG}
scripts.build:file-server: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman build -f ./file-server.Containerfile --platform linux/amd64 -t polis-file-server:${TAG} ../../
scripts.build:math: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman build -f ./math.Containerfile --platform linux/amd64 -t polis-math:${TAG} ../../math
scripts.build:server: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman build -f ./server.Containerfile --platform linux/amd64 -t polis-server:${TAG} ../../server
scripts.build:reverse-proxy: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman build -f ./reverse-proxy.Containerfile --platform linux/amd64 -t polis-reverse-proxy:${TAG} .
scripts.build:postgres: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman build -f ./postgres.Containerfile --platform linux/amd64 -t polis-postgres:${TAG} ../../database
scripts.build:compose: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build  --platform linux/amd64 --parallel
scripts.run:compose: npm run _prompt && TAG=${TAG:-latest} && podman compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
